title: GRACE: Generation-aware latent compression for efficient video generation
title_zh: GRACE：面向高效视频生成的感知生成能力的潜在压缩方法

paragraphs.en: Highly compressed video autoencoders offer an effective way to accelerate video diffusion models, since the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) then operates on far fewer tokens. However, such autoencoders are difficult to obtain: a higher compression ratio degrades reconstruction quality, and recovering it requires more latent channels, which is known to slow DiT convergence. Moreover, the compressed latent space differs from the one the DiT was trained on, so the pretrained DiT must either be retrained from scratch or adapted at considerable cost. Further compressing the autoencoder that the DiT was trained with may seem to preserve compatibility, yet optimizing it for reconstruction alone still shifts the latent away from the distribution the DiT has learned. To address this, we propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE) , a two-stage framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while keeping it compatible with the pretrained DiT. In the first stage, we retain the base latent produced by the frozen pretrained encoder and learn a residual latent that captures the information lost under stronger compression. We further align the compressed latent with the pretrained latent in the feature space of the frozen DiT, so that the autoencoder is optimized for generation rather than reconstruction alone. In the second stage, we adapt the DiT through lightweight fine-tuning and asymmetric denoising, in which the base latent is denoised ahead of the residual latent. GRACE reduces the token count of Wan2.1-I2V-14B by nearly 𝟖 × 8\times and its latency by 11.1 × 11.1\times at 480 × 832 480{\times}832 resolution with 81 frames, while matching the VBench generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression.
paragraphs.zh: 高度压缩的视频自编码器为加速视频扩散模型提供了一种有效方法，因为扩散变换器（DiT）此时只需处理远更少的标记。 然而，这类自编码器难以获得：更高的压缩比会降低重建质量，而恢复这种质量则需要更多潜在通道，这已被证实会减缓 DiT 的收敛速度。 此外，压缩后的潜在空间与 DiT 训练时使用的潜在空间存在差异，因此预训练的 DiT 要么必须从头重新训练，要么需要付出巨大代价进行适配。 进一步压缩 DiT 训练所用的自编码器看似能保持兼容性，但仅针对重建进行优化仍会使潜在空间偏离 DiT 已学习的分布。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了“面向高效视频生成的感知生成潜在压缩”（GRACE），这是一种两阶段框架，可在保持与预训练 DiT 兼容性的同时压缩预训练视频自编码器。 在第一阶段，我们保留由冻结的预训练编码器生成的基础潜在表示，并学习一个残差潜在表示以捕捉更强压缩下丢失的信息。 我们进一步在冻结 DiT 的特征空间中，使压缩后的潜在表示与预训练的潜在表示对齐，从而让自编码器针对生成而非仅针对重建进行优化。 在第二阶段，我们通过轻量级微调和非对称去噪对 DiT 进行适配，其中基础潜在表示会先于残差潜在表示被去噪。 GRACE 在 480×832 分辨率和 81 帧的条件下，将 Wan2.1-I2V-14B 的标记数量减少了近 8 倍，延迟降低了 11.1 倍，同时其生成质量与压缩前预训练流程在 VBench 上的表现一致。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in video diffusion models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ) have demonstrated remarkable generation quality, yet their computational cost remains a significant bottleneck for both training and inference. This computational cost largely depends on the number of tokens processed by the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , whose attention scales quadratically with sequence length.
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型的最新进展（Wan 等，2025；Ma 等，2025；HaCohen 等，2024）已展现出卓越的生成质量，但其计算成本仍然是训练和推理过程中的重大瓶颈。 这种计算成本在很大程度上取决于扩散变换器（DiT）（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）处理的令牌数量，其注意力机制的计算量随序列长度呈二次方增长。

sents.en: Recent advances in video diffusion models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ) have demonstrated remarkable generation quality, yet their computational cost remains a significant bottleneck for both training and inference.
sents.zh: 视频扩散模型的最新进展（Wan 等，2025；Ma 等，2025；HaCohen 等，2024）已展现出卓越的生成质量，但其计算成本仍然是训练和推理过程中的重大瓶颈。

sents.zh: 这种计算成本在很大程度上取决于扩散变换器（DiT）（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）处理的令牌数量，其注意力机制的计算量随序列长度呈二次方增长。

paragraphs.en: The number of input tokens scales with the spatio-temporal resolution of the latent produced by the video autoencoder ( Wan et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ) . Therefore, increasing the autoencoder compression ratio provides a straightforward way to reduce computation. However, fewer tokens limit the representational capacity of the latent, leading to a significant drop in reconstruction quality ( Yao et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 输入令牌的数量会随着视频自编码器生成的潜在表示的空间-时间分辨率而缩放（Wan 等人，2025；HaCohen 等人，2024）。 因此，提高自编码器的压缩比是减少计算量的直接方法。 然而，更少的令牌会限制潜在表示的表达能力，从而导致重建质量显著下降（Yao 等人，2025）。

sents.en: The number of input tokens scales with the spatio-temporal resolution of the latent produced by the video autoencoder ( Wan et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 输入令牌的数量会随着视频自编码器生成的潜在表示的空间-时间分辨率而缩放（Wan 等人，2025；HaCohen 等人，2024）。

sents.en: Therefore, increasing the autoencoder compression ratio provides a straightforward way to reduce computation.
sents.zh: 因此，提高自编码器的压缩比是减少计算量的直接方法。

sents.en: However, fewer tokens limit the representational capacity of the latent, leading to a significant drop in reconstruction quality ( Yao et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 然而，更少的令牌会限制潜在表示的表达能力，从而导致重建质量显著下降（Yao 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: To preserve reconstruction quality with fewer tokens, previous works ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025c ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) increase the channel dimension of each token. However, higher-dimensional latents are known to compromise generation quality, introducing a trade-off between reconstruction and generation quality ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , and they converge more slowly, raising the training cost. Moreover, modifying the autoencoder architecture typically requires retraining the autoencoder from scratch, making it difficult to fully leverage pretrained knowledge and incurring substantial training cost. Reusing a released high-compression autoencoder avoids such cost but passes the burden to the pretrained DiT, which must adapt to a latent space never seen during pretraining and may not fully converge even on 160 GPUs ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . A natural alternative is to leverage a pretrained autoencoder by adding a lightweight compression block to its architecture. However, we empirically find that this approach still degrades generation quality (Tabs. 1 and 4 ). Optimizing the autoencoder and the additional compression block solely for reconstruction shifts the resulting latent distribution away from that learned by the pretrained DiT, degrading generation quality ( He et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了以更少的 token 保留重建质量，先前的研究（Chen et al., 2025a；Chen et al., 2025c；HaCohen et al., 2024；Zheng et al., 2026；Ma et al., 2025）增加了每个 token 的通道维度。 然而，已知更高维度的潜在变量会损害生成质量，在重建质量和生成质量之间引入权衡（Yao et al., 2025），并且它们的收敛速度更慢，从而增加了训练成本。 此外，修改自编码器架构通常需要从头开始重新训练自编码器，这使得充分利用预训练知识变得困难，并产生巨大的训练成本。 复用已发布的高压缩自编码器可以避免这种成本，但会将负担转嫁给预训练的 DiT，后者必须适应在预训练期间从未见过的潜在空间，并且即使在 160 块 GPU 上也可能无法完全收敛（Zheng et al., 2026）。 一种自然的替代方案是利用预训练的自编码器，在其架构中添加一个轻量级的压缩模块。 然而，我们通过实证发现，这种方法仍然会降低生成质量（表 1 和表 4）。 仅针对重建对自编码器和额外的压缩模块进行优化，会使最终的潜在分布偏离预训练 DiT 所学习的分布，从而降低生成质量（He et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2024）。

sents.en: To preserve reconstruction quality with fewer tokens, previous works ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025c ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) increase the channel dimension of each token.
sents.zh: 为了以更少的 token 保留重建质量，先前的研究（Chen et al., 2025a；Chen et al., 2025c；HaCohen et al., 2024；Zheng et al., 2026；Ma et al., 2025）增加了每个 token 的通道维度。

sents.zh: 然而，已知更高维度的潜在变量会损害生成质量，在重建质量和生成质量之间引入权衡（Yao et al., 2025），并且它们的收敛速度更慢，从而增加了训练成本。

sents.en: Moreover, modifying the autoencoder architecture typically requires retraining the autoencoder from scratch, making it difficult to fully leverage pretrained knowledge and incurring substantial training cost.
sents.zh: 此外，修改自编码器架构通常需要从头开始重新训练自编码器，这使得充分利用预训练知识变得困难，并产生巨大的训练成本。

sents.en: Reusing a released high-compression autoencoder avoids such cost but passes the burden to the pretrained DiT, which must adapt to a latent space never seen during pretraining and may not fully converge even on 160 GPUs ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 复用已发布的高压缩自编码器可以避免这种成本，但会将负担转嫁给预训练的 DiT，后者必须适应在预训练期间从未见过的潜在空间，并且即使在 160 块 GPU 上也可能无法完全收敛（Zheng et al., 2026）。

sents.en: A natural alternative is to leverage a pretrained autoencoder by adding a lightweight compression block to its architecture.
sents.zh: 一种自然的替代方案是利用预训练的自编码器，在其架构中添加一个轻量级的压缩模块。

sents.en: However, we empirically find that this approach still degrades generation quality (Tabs. 1 and 4 ).
sents.zh: 然而，我们通过实证发现，这种方法仍然会降低生成质量（表 1 和表 4）。

sents.en: Optimizing the autoencoder and the additional compression block solely for reconstruction shifts the resulting latent distribution away from that learned by the pretrained DiT, degrading generation quality ( He et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 仅针对重建对自编码器和额外的压缩模块进行优化，会使最终的潜在分布偏离预训练 DiT 所学习的分布，从而降低生成质量（He et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: These observations point to two key challenges in efficient latent compression: (1) efficiently adapting pretrained autoencoder and DiT models while fully leveraging their pretrained knowledge, and (2) reducing the gap between reconstruction and generation quality introduced by compression. Our key insight is that a pretrained autoencoder and DiT already form a well-aligned generative pipeline, and this alignment can be exploited during compression. We therefore propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE) , a training framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while explicitly accounting for both reconstruction and generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 这些观察结果揭示了高效潜在压缩中的两个关键挑战：（1）在充分利用预训练知识的同时，高效地适配预训练的自编码器和 DiT 模型；以及（2）缩小压缩所导致的重建质量与生成质量之间的差距。 我们的核心见解是，预训练的自编码器和 DiT 已经构成了一个高度协调的生成流程，而这种协调性可以在压缩过程中加以利用。 因此，我们提出了“面向高效视频生成的生成感知潜在压缩”（GRACE）框架——一种在训练时同时考虑重建质量和生成质量的预训练视频自编码器压缩方法。

sents.zh: 这些观察结果揭示了高效潜在压缩中的两个关键挑战：（1）在充分利用预训练知识的同时，高效地适配预训练的自编码器和 DiT 模型；以及（2）缩小压缩所导致的重建质量与生成质量之间的差距。

sents.en: Our key insight is that a pretrained autoencoder and DiT already form a well-aligned generative pipeline, and this alignment can be exploited during compression.
sents.zh: 我们的核心见解是，预训练的自编码器和 DiT 已经构成了一个高度协调的生成流程，而这种协调性可以在压缩过程中加以利用。

sents.en: We therefore propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE) , a training framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while explicitly accounting for both reconstruction and generation quality.
sents.zh: 因此，我们提出了“面向高效视频生成的生成感知潜在压缩”（GRACE）框架——一种在训练时同时考虑重建质量和生成质量的预训练视频自编码器压缩方法。

paragraphs.en: First, to fully leverage the pretrained autoencoder, we introduce a dual-latent representation that separates the pretrained representation from the information lost to compression. The base latent is obtained from the pretrained autoencoder using a spatially and temporally downsampled input, preserving the representation already learned by the pretrained autoencoder. The residual latent then captures the spatial detail and inter-frame motion that the low-resolution base latent cannot represent. This design allows the compressed autoencoder to retain the pretrained representation while using the residual latent only to complement what the downsampled input leaves out.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，为了充分利用预训练自编码器，我们引入了一种双潜在表示，将预训练表示与压缩过程中丢失的信息分离开来。 基础潜在变量通过空间和时间下采样的输入从预训练自编码器中获得，从而保留了预训练自编码器已经学到的表示。 随后，残差潜在变量捕捉到低分辨率的基础潜在变量无法表示的空间细节和帧间运动。 这种设计使得压缩后的自编码器能够保留预训练表示，同时仅使用残差潜在变量来补充下采样输入所遗漏的信息。

sents.en: First, to fully leverage the pretrained autoencoder, we introduce a dual-latent representation that separates the pretrained representation from the information lost to compression.
sents.zh: 首先，为了充分利用预训练自编码器，我们引入了一种双潜在表示，将预训练表示与压缩过程中丢失的信息分离开来。

sents.en: The base latent is obtained from the pretrained autoencoder using a spatially and temporally downsampled input, preserving the representation already learned by the pretrained autoencoder.
sents.zh: 基础潜在变量通过空间和时间下采样的输入从预训练自编码器中获得，从而保留了预训练自编码器已经学到的表示。

sents.en: The residual latent then captures the spatial detail and inter-frame motion that the low-resolution base latent cannot represent.
sents.zh: 随后，残差潜在变量捕捉到低分辨率的基础潜在变量无法表示的空间细节和帧间运动。

sents.en: This design allows the compressed autoencoder to retain the pretrained representation while using the residual latent only to complement what the downsampled input leaves out.
sents.zh: 这种设计使得压缩后的自编码器能够保留预训练表示，同时仅使用残差潜在变量来补充下采样输入所遗漏的信息。

paragraphs.en: Second, we introduce asymmetric denoising to exploit this separation during generation. The base latent is denoised at an earlier timestep than the residual latent, allowing the denoised base to provide a stable anchor for the residual to recover the missing information. Both latents are denoised within a single pass, introducing no additional sampling cost.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，我们引入非对称去噪，以便在生成过程中利用这种分离。 基础潜在变量在更早的时间步进行去噪，而非残差潜在变量，这样去噪后的基础部分就能为残差部分提供一个稳定的锚点，以恢复缺失的信息。 两种潜在变量都在单次处理中完成去噪，不会引入额外的采样成本。

sents.en: Second, we introduce asymmetric denoising to exploit this separation during generation.
sents.zh: 其次，我们引入非对称去噪，以便在生成过程中利用这种分离。

sents.en: The base latent is denoised at an earlier timestep than the residual latent, allowing the denoised base to provide a stable anchor for the residual to recover the missing information.
sents.zh: 基础潜在变量在更早的时间步进行去噪，而非残差潜在变量，这样去噪后的基础部分就能为残差部分提供一个稳定的锚点，以恢复缺失的信息。

sents.en: Both latents are denoised within a single pass, introducing no additional sampling cost.
sents.zh: 两种潜在变量都在单次处理中完成去噪，不会引入额外的采样成本。

paragraphs.en: Finally, to preserve compatibility with the pretrained DiT, we introduce generation-aware alignment, which matches the compressed autoencoder latent with the pretrained latent in the DiT’s feature space. Rather than relying solely on conventional reconstruction objectives such as L1/L2 and perceptual losses ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , we use intermediate DiT features to measure the distance between the compressed and pretrained latents. This generation-aware alignment encourages the compressed latent to remain compatible with the distribution learned by the pretrained DiT, thereby reducing the gap between reconstruction and generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，为了保持与预训练 DiT 的兼容性，我们引入了生成感知对齐机制，该机制将压缩自编码器的潜在表示与 DiT 特征空间中的预训练潜在表示进行匹配。 与其仅依赖 L1/L2 和感知损失（Zhang et al., 2018）等传统重建目标，我们使用 DiT 的中间特征来衡量压缩潜在表示与预训练潜在表示之间的距离。 这种生成感知对齐机制促使压缩后的潜在表示保持与预训练 DiT 所学习分布的兼容性，从而缩小重建质量与生成质量之间的差距。

sents.en: Finally, to preserve compatibility with the pretrained DiT, we introduce generation-aware alignment, which matches the compressed autoencoder latent with the pretrained latent in the DiT’s feature space.
sents.zh: 最后，为了保持与预训练 DiT 的兼容性，我们引入了生成感知对齐机制，该机制将压缩自编码器的潜在表示与 DiT 特征空间中的预训练潜在表示进行匹配。

paragraphs.en: We summarize our contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose GRACE, a diffusion training framework that efficiently compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while preserving the pretrained autoencoder–DiT pipeline and narrowing the reconstruction–generation gap.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GRACE，一种扩散训练框架，能够在高效压缩预训练视频自编码器的同时，保留预训练的自编码器–DiT 流程，并缩小重建与生成之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a dual-latent representation with asymmetric denoising to preserve the pretrained autoencoder representation while recovering the spatial detail and inter-frame motion that the downsampled input leaves out.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种具有非对称去噪能力的双潜在表示方法，该方法在保留预训练自编码器表示的同时，能够恢复下采样输入所丢失的空间细节和帧间运动。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a generation-aware alignment objective in the feature space of the pretrained DiT to preserve its compatibility with the compressed autoencoder.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在预训练的 DiT 的特征空间中引入了一种感知生成的对齐目标，以保留其与压缩自编码器的兼容性。

paragraphs.en: Our method reduces the token count by nearly 8 × 8\times , compressing both axes at once to 16 × 16\times spatial and 8 × 8\times temporal, while matching the generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on VBench with an 11.1 × 11.1\times reduction in latency at 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 and a 15.5 × 15.5\times reduction at 736 × 1280 × 81 736{\times}1280{\times}81 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法将令牌数量减少了近 8 × 8\times，同时压缩两个轴至 16 × 16\times 的空间分辨率和 8 × 8\times 的时间分辨率，同时在 VBench 上实现了与压缩前预训练流程相当的生成质量，在 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 时延迟降低了 11.1 × 11.1\times，在 736 × 1280 × 81 736{\times}1280{\times}81 时延迟降低了 15.5 × 15.5\times。

paragraphs.en: Latent compression for efficient video generation. Video diffusion models are computationally expensive since they repeatedly denoise a large number of latent tokens. Existing acceleration methods either reduce the number of denoising steps ( Song et al., 2022 ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , often at the cost of quality, or reduce the computation per step ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ) . Several works ( HaCohen et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2025 ) instead propose to compress the latent beyond the common setting of 8 × 8\times spatial and 4 × 4\times temporal compression (f8t4), which significantly lowers the token count by a fixed ratio. Existing approaches increase spatial compression through autoencoder architectural changes ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Tian et al., 2025 ) , or progressively increase temporal compression ( Mahapatra et al., 2025 ) . A complementary strategy assigns more channels to each token to preserve reconstruction quality at high compression ratios, but wider latents can degrade generation quality, which recent work addresses by structuring the channel dimension ( Chen et al., 2025c ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . Our work compresses the video autoencoder in both space and time by fine-tuning a pretrained autoencoder and DiT rather than training either from scratch, keeping training cost low while mainly addressing the generation quality and convergence issues introduced by increased channel capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在压缩：实现高效视频生成。 视频扩散模型的计算成本高昂，因为它们需要反复去除大量潜在标记的噪声。 现有的加速方法要么减少去噪步骤的数量（Song et al., 2022；Lu et al., 2022；Zhao et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2024；Li et al., 2024），但通常会以牺牲质量为代价；要么减少每一步的计算量（Xi et al., 2025；Sun et al., 2025）。 一些研究（HaCohen et al., 2024；Zheng et al., 2026；Tian et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025b；Ma et al., 2025）则提出，将潜在表示的压缩程度超越常见的 8×8 空间压缩和 4×4 时间压缩（f8t4）设置，从而以固定比例显著降低标记数量。 现有方法通过自编码器架构的调整来提高空间压缩度（Chen et al., 2025a；Tian et al., 2025），或逐步增强时间压缩度（Mahapatra et al., 2025）。 一种互补策略是为每个标记分配更多通道，以在高压缩比下保持重建质量；但更宽的潜在表示可能会降低生成质量，而近期研究通过结构化通道维度解决了这一问题（Chen et al., 2025c；Cai et al., 2026）。 我们的工作通过对预训练的自编码器和 DiT 进行微调，而非从头训练两者，从而在空间和时间两个维度上压缩了视频自编码器。这种方法既保持了较低的训练成本，又主要解决了因通道容量增加而引发的生成质量和收敛问题。

paragraphs.en: Autoencoder adaptation for pretrained generators. A few recent works redesign or improve the autoencoder in generation pipelines ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025c ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . One line of work regularizes the latent with a pretrained vision foundation model so that a diffusion model learns it more easily ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , but trains both the autoencoder and the generator from scratch. Changing the latent space in this way typically requires retraining the DiT from scratch at prohibitive cost, since the new latent distribution no longer matches the one on which the DiT was trained. To avoid this cost, other works reuse the pretrained DiT and close the resulting mismatch during training ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Some constrain the new latent to remain reconstructable by the pretrained decoder ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , while others align patch embeddings between the pretrained and modified pipelines after the latent space has already diverged ( He et al., 2026 ) . We instead optimize the autoencoder latent with intermediate features from the frozen DiT, keeping it close to the representation space where the pretrained generator operates.
paragraphs.zh: 为预训练生成器适配自编码器。 近期一些研究重新设计或改进了生成流程中的自编码器（Zheng 等，2025；Chen 等，2025c；Cai 等，2026）。 一类研究使用预训练的视觉基础模型对潜在空间进行正则化，以便扩散模型能更轻松地学习它（Yao 等，2025），但这种方法需要从头训练自编码器和生成器。 以这种方式改变潜在空间通常需要以高昂的成本从头重新训练 DiT，因为新的潜在分布与 DiT 训练时所用的分布不再匹配。 为避免这种成本，其他研究会复用预训练的 DiT，并在训练过程中消除由此产生的不匹配（Zheng 等，2026）。 一些研究通过约束新潜在空间仍能被预训练解码器重建来保持其可重建性（Zhao 等，2024），而另一些研究则在潜在空间已经发散后，对齐预训练和修改后的流程中的块嵌入（He 等，2026）。 我们则使用冻结的 DiT 提供的中间特征来优化自编码器的潜在空间，使其保持接近预训练生成器所操作的表示空间。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we briefly review latent video diffusion models, which consist of a video autoencoder that compresses videos into a latent space and a diffusion transformer that generates within that space. The autoencoder encodes a video into a latent and decodes a latent back into a video, while the diffusion transformer learns to denoise noisy latents.

paragraphs.en: We propose GRACE , a two-stage framework that compresses the latent of a pretrained pipeline while preserving generation quality (Fig. 2 ). Stage 1 fine-tunes the autoencoder into a dual latent of a frozen base and a learned residual, guided by the frozen DiT (Section 4.2 ). Stage 2 adapts the DiT to that latent, denoising the base ahead of the residual (Section 4.3 ). In both stages, the pretrained pipeline before compression guides its own compression.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GRACE，一个两阶段框架，能够在压缩预训练流程的潜在表示的同时保留生成质量（图 2）。 第一阶段通过冻结的 DiT 指导，将自编码器微调为一个双潜在表示，包括一个冻结的基础部分和一个学习到的残差部分（第 4.2 节）。 第二阶段将 DiT 与该潜在表示进行适配，先对基础部分去噪，再处理残差部分（第 4.3 节）。 在两个阶段中，压缩前的预训练流程都指导着自身的压缩过程。

paragraphs.en: We make full use of the pretrained autoencoder, keeping its architecture and weights, which keeps the latent close to the pretrained DiT’s latent space and avoids training from scratch. A.1 ). This already gives a strong baseline, reconstructing within the range of high-compression autoencoders trained from scratch (Tab. 1 ). The latent drifts to optimize the objective, leaving the DiT with more to adapt to in Stage 2.

paragraphs.en: Generation-aware alignment in pretrained DiT feature space. The dual-latent representation alone narrows the gap between the compressed latent and the pretrained latent space, but we find it insufficient at higher compression ratios, where the residual latent must carry more information missing from the base. The residual channels are optimized only through the reconstruction objective, which improves fidelity but does not directly account for how easily the diffusion model can learn the resulting latent. We introduce generation-aware alignment, a regularizer that supervises the compressed latent inside the feature space of the pretrained DiT without modifying the autoencoder architecture. Our approach builds on the same insight as prior autoencoder adaptation methods: reconstruction fidelity alone does not necessarily yield a compressed latent that the diffusion backbone can learn effectively ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025c ) . Since the pretrained DiT is already adapted to the original latent space, we compare the two latents in its intermediate feature space. We perturb both latents with a shared τ \tau drawn from the pretrained pipeline’s schedule and independently sampled ϵ \bm{\epsilon} . The alignment loss is then defined by passing both noised latents through this frozen DiT and matching their intermediate representations. For the pretrained latent, the frozen encoder encodes the full-resolution video, and 𝐯 θ \mathbf{v}_{\theta} patchifies the resulting latent through the original input projection W in W_{\text{in}} before the transformer blocks:

sents.zh: 仅通过双重潜在表示，可以缩小压缩潜在空间与预训练潜在空间之间的差距，但我们发现，在更高的压缩比率下，这种表示仍显不足，因为此时残差潜在空间必须承载更多原始基础中缺失的信息。

sents.en: The residual channels are optimized only through the reconstruction objective, which improves fidelity but does not directly account for how easily the diffusion model can learn the resulting latent.

sents.en: We introduce generation-aware alignment, a regularizer that supervises the compressed latent inside the feature space of the pretrained DiT without modifying the autoencoder architecture.
sents.zh: 我们引入了具备生成感知的对齐机制——一种正则化器，它能在不修改自编码器架构的前提下，于预训练 DiT 的特征空间内对压缩后的潜在空间进行监督。

sents.en: Our approach builds on the same insight as prior autoencoder adaptation methods: reconstruction fidelity alone does not necessarily yield a compressed latent that the diffusion backbone can learn effectively ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025c ) .

paragraphs.en: In this section, we adapt the pretrained DiT to the compressed latent while keeping the autoencoder frozen. Since the compressed latent adds C ′ C^{\prime} unseen channels, we extend the DiT input and output projections from C C to C + C ′ C+C^{\prime} channels. We fully fine-tune these projections and apply LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) to the transformer blocks, keeping the adaptation cost low while preserving the pretrained generation capability ( He et al., 2026 ) . The DiT is trained with the flow matching loss ℒ velocity \mathcal{L}_{\text{velocity}} , applied to the base and the residual latent at different noise levels, which we describe next.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation details. We evaluate reconstruction on Panda-70M ( Chen et al., 2024 ) with PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , and rFVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2019 ) , and generation on VBench-I2V ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . We compare against publicly released video autoencoders that compress more aggressively than Wan2.1-VAE, with the pretrained pipeline before compression as the reference. The compared autoencoders are trained independently of Wan2.1-VAE, whereas our single-latent baseline and GRACE-VAE are fine-tuned from it. To measure generation, we adapt the pretrained Wan2.1-I2V-14B to every latent under the same total budget of 38.5 H200 GPU days. The compared latents spend the whole budget on DiT adaptation, while our pipeline spends 8.5 days on the autoencoder and 30 on the DiT. Our adaptation builds on the frozen Wan2.1 base latent, which is unavailable to the compared autoencoders, so we instead transfer them with the released implementation of DC-Gen ( He et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) , which is designed to adapt a pretrained DiT to a new latent space (see Appendix C.1 for the adaptation details).
paragraphs.zh: 评估细节。 我们在 Panda-70M（Chen 等人，2024）上通过 PSNR、SSIM（Wang 等人，2004）、LPIPS（Zhang 等人，2018）和 rFVD（Unterthiner 等人，2019）评估重建效果，并在 VBench-I2V（Huang 等人，2023；Huang 等人，2024）上评估生成效果。 我们将方法与公开发布的视频自编码器进行比较，这些自编码器的压缩强度高于 Wan2.1-VAE，并以压缩前的预训练流程作为参考。 所比较的自编码器均独立于 Wan2.1-VAE 进行训练，而我们的单潜在基线模型和 GRACE-VAE 则是基于该模型进行微调的。 为衡量生成效果，我们在相同的总预算（38.5 H200 GPU 天）下，将预训练的 Wan2.1-I2V-14B 适配到每个潜在空间。 所比较的潜在模型将整个预算用于 DiT 适配，而我们的流程则将 8.5 天用于自编码器，30 天用于 DiT。 我们的适配方法基于冻结的 Wan2.1 基础潜在模型，但该模型对比较中的自编码器不可用，因此我们转而使用已发布的 DC-Gen（He 等人，2026；Chen 等人，2025b）实现进行迁移，该实现旨在将预训练的 DiT 适配到新的潜在空间（适配细节见附录 C.1）。

paragraphs.en: Main results. As shown in Tab. 1 , better reconstruction does not mean better generation. Step-Video-VAE reconstructs 1.91 dB above LTX-VAE but scores 3.01 lower on VBench-I2V, even at 4 × 4\times the tokens, and our single-latent baseline reconstructs 1.13 dB above GRACE-VAE yet scores 1.46 lower. GRACE-VAE reaches the highest generation quality among the compressed autoencoders at the smallest token count, within 0.02 of the pretrained pipeline, while Video DC-AE and Step-Video-VAE use 2 × 2\times and 4 × 4\times more tokens yet score 2.98 and 3.87 lower than the pretrained pipeline.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation details. We evaluate on VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) for both I2V and T2V at 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 with 50 sampling steps, generating one video per prompt over the full benchmark, and measure latency on a single A100 GPU. paragraphs.en: Main results. As shown in Tab. 2 , GRACE stays within 0.02 of the pretrained pipeline before compression on I2V and exceeds it on T2V, while running 11.1 × 11.1\times faster. The T2V gain comes mostly from the semantic score, where GRACE leads the next best model by 5.28. The ablation in Tab. 4 traces this gain to both stages: the dual latent alone keeps the semantic score at the pretrained level, and generation-aware alignment and the base-ahead offset raise it by 3.90 and 2.43. At 736 × 1280 × 81 736{\times}1280{\times}81 (Tab. 3 ), GRACE again reaches the highest T2V total at the lowest latency and stays within 0.04 of the pretrained pipeline on I2V while running 15.5 × 15.5\times faster.

paragraphs.en: Quantitative comparison. In Tabs. 2 and 3 , the most direct comparison is DC-Gen, which adapts the same pretrained DiT at twice our token count. GRACE runs faster than DC-Gen and scores higher on every VBench total, although DC-Gen is higher on the quality scores at 736 × 1280 × 81 736{\times}1280{\times}81 , which we examine in the qualitative comparison below. GRACE also follows the conditioning image more closely, leading DC-Gen on the I2V score by 7.23 at 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 . LTX-Video reaches a higher I2V total at the same token count but runs slower, since a third guidance branch adds a DiT pass per step. On T2V, however, LTX-Video scores 6.64 below GRACE at 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 . Open-Sora 2.0 uses about twice our token count, yet runs slower and has the lowest VBench totals in both tasks at both resolutions. I.7 – I.9 ). GRACE instead stays close to the color and style of the pretrained pipeline.

paragraphs.en: Most of the training cost lies in adapting the DiT to the compressed latent. Reusing the pretrained DiT reduces this cost substantially, since a DiT trained from scratch for the same number of steps falls far behind on both VBench-T2V and VBench-I2V (Tab. 4 , rows II and III). Reuse alone is not sufficient, however, as Open-Sora 2.0 reports blurry videos that do not fully converge even on 160 GPUs after adapting a pretrained DiT to Video DC-AE, an autoencoder trained from scratch ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Under the same budget, both the Video DC-AE latent and our single-latent baseline fall short of the pretrained pipeline, although the latter is fine-tuned from the pretrained autoencoder with ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}} (Tab. 1 ). The adaptation cost thus appears to depend on how easily the pretrained DiT can learn the latent, which ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}} alone does not account for. Adding ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} makes the residual converge faster to a lower flow matching loss (Fig. 7 ), while the base channels behave almost identically, since the DiT already models the base latent space. As a result, GRACE matches the pretrained pipeline with 8.5 H200 GPU days for the autoencoder and 30 for the DiT.
paragraphs.zh: 大部分训练成本都用于将 DiT 适配到压缩后的潜在表示上。 复用预训练的 DiT 能大幅降低这一成本，因为从头开始以相同步数训练的 DiT 在 VBench-T2V 和 VBench-I2V 上的表现都明显落后（表 4，第 II 行和第 III 行）。 然而，仅靠复用并不足够，因为 Open-Sora 2.0 报告称，即使使用 160 块 GPU，在将预训练的 DiT 适配到从头训练的自动编码器 Video DC-AE 后，生成的视频仍然模糊且未完全收敛（Zheng et al., 2026）。 在相同预算下，Video DC-AE 的潜在表示和我们的单潜在基线模型均不如预训练流程，尽管后者是基于预训练的自动编码器并使用 ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}} 进行微调的（表 1）。 因此，适配成本似乎取决于预训练的 DiT 学习该潜在表示的难易程度，而仅靠 ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}} 无法反映这一点。 加入 ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} 后，残差能更快地收敛到更低的流匹配损失（图 7），而基础通道的表现几乎相同，因为 DiT 已经对基础潜在空间进行了建模。 因此，GRACE 在自动编码器上需要 8.5 个 H200 GPU 日，在 DiT 上需要 30 个 H200 GPU 日，即可与预训练流程相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Ablation on design components. Each component in Tab. 4 improves generation on both tasks. The dual latent and the offset raise the T2V total by 1.43 and 1.13 but the I2V total by only 0.20 and 0.39, as both determine what the generation is anchored to, whereas I2V already provides the conditioning image as an anchor. The dual latent also makes the alignment possible, since ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} needs a pretrained latent to match against. Alignment behaves differently, raising the I2V score as well as both T2V scores, since the conditioning image anchors the content but does not resolve the mismatch between the compressed latent and the DiT’s pretrained denoising space. Alignment therefore recovers most of the gap to the pretrained pipeline on I2V and goes further on T2V, where the total ends up above that pipeline, which may relate to the latent structure that the alignment loss induces (Fig. 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对设计组件的消融分析。 表4中的每个组件都能提升两项任务中的生成效果。 双重潜在变量和偏移量使T2V总分分别提升了1.43和1.13，但I2V总分仅提升了0.20和0.39，因为两者都决定了生成内容所锚定的对象，而I2V已经通过条件图像提供了锚点。 双重潜在变量也使得对齐成为可能，因为对齐损失函数ℒ_align需要与一个预训练的潜在变量进行匹配。 对齐机制的表现有所不同：它不仅提升了I2V得分，也提升了两项T2V得分，因为条件图像虽然锚定了内容，但并未解决压缩后的潜在变量与DiT预训练去噪空间之间的不匹配问题。 因此，对齐机制在I2V任务上基本弥补了与预训练流程之间的差距，并在T2V任务上更进一步，其总分甚至超过了该预训练流程；这可能与对齐损失所引入的潜在变量结构有关（图3）。

paragraphs.en: Alignment target. We align the compressed latent inside the pretrained DiT (Section 4.2 ), and Tab. 5 assesses the impact of the alignment target while keeping everything else fixed. Prior work regularizes a high-dimensional latent with a pretrained vision foundation model so that it is easier for a diffusion model to learn ( Yao et al., 2025 ) . For that comparison, we use V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) , a video foundation model whose dense features are spatially structured and temporally consistent. We keep the loss, the adaptive weighting, and the structure of P l P_{l} , and replace the target with V-JEPA 2.1 features of the clean video, applying P l P_{l} directly to the compressed latent since the target is no longer in the DiT feature space (see Appendix C.3 for the setup). Aligning to V-JEPA 2.1 raises the semantic score from 78.65 to 80.04, while aligning inside the pretrained DiT raises it far higher, to 82.55, with the totals following the same order. These results suggest that vision foundation models provide useful semantic structure in general, but in our setting, the relevant structure is the one already represented by the pretrained DiT, since the compressed autoencoder is adapted to a fixed denoising model.
paragraphs.zh: 对齐目标。 我们将压缩后的潜在变量与预训练的 DiT（第 4.2 节）进行对齐，表 5 评估了在保持其他一切不变的情况下，对齐目标所带来的影响。 先前的工作通过一个预训练的视觉基础模型对高维潜在变量进行正则化，从而让扩散模型更容易学习（Yao et al., 2025）。 为了进行比较，我们使用了 V-JEPA 2.1（Mur-Labadia et al., 2026），这是一个视频基础模型，其密集特征在空间上具有结构，并且在时间上一致。 我们保留了损失函数、自适应加权以及 P l P_{l} 的结构，并将目标替换为干净视频的 V-JEPA 2.1 特征，直接将对 P l P_{l} 应用于压缩后的潜在变量，因为此时目标已不再位于 DiT 的特征空间中（具体设置参见附录 C.3）。 与 V-JEPA 2.1 对齐将语义分数从 78.65 提升至 80.04，而在预训练的 DiT 内部进行对齐则将其进一步提升至 82.55，总得分也遵循相同的顺序。 这些结果表明，视觉基础模型通常能提供有用的语义结构，但在我们的设定中，相关的结构是预训练的 DiT 已经表示的结构，因为压缩自编码器是适配于一个固定的去噪模型的。

paragraphs.en: We presented GRACE, a framework that compresses the latent of a pretrained video diffusion pipeline and adapts the DiT to the compressed latent. GRACE keeps a frozen base latent and learns a residual latent for the information lost under stronger compression, aligns the compressed latent with the pretrained latent in the feature space of the frozen DiT, and denoises the base ahead of the residual so that the residual builds on a settled base. GRACE matches the VBench generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on Wan2.1-I2V-14B while running 11.1 × 11.1\times faster at 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 , and the speedup grows with resolution, reaching 15.5 × 15.5\times at 736 × 1280 × 81 736{\times}1280{\times}81 . Across the compared autoencoders, better reconstruction does not mean better generation. Optimizing the autoencoder for reconstruction alone moves the latent away from the distribution the DiT has learned, which is why GRACE supervises compression in the space the DiT operates in.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GRACE，这是一个压缩预训练视频扩散流程的潜在表示，并将 DiT 适配到压缩后潜在表示的框架。 GRACE 保留一个冻结的基础潜在表示，并学习一个残差潜在表示以补偿更强压缩下丢失的信息；它将在冻结 DiT 的特征空间中使压缩后的潜在表示与预训练的潜在表示对齐，并先对基础部分进行去噪，再处理残差部分，从而让残差能够建立在稳定的基础之上。 GRACE 在 Wan2.1-I2V-14B 模型上实现了与压缩前预训练流程相同的 VBench 生成质量，同时运行速度提升了 11.1 × 11.1\times（在 480 × 832 × 81 736{\times}832{\times}81 分辨率下），且随着分辨率的提升，加速效果进一步增强，在 736 × 1280 × 81 736{\times}1280{\times}81 分辨率下达到 15.5 × 15.5\times。 在比较的多种自动编码器中，更优的重建效果并不意味着更优的生成效果。 仅针对重建进行自动编码器的优化，会使潜在表示偏离 DiT 已学习的分布，因此 GRACE 选择在 DiT 所操作的空间中对压缩过程进行监督。

paragraphs.en: Base encoding. We obtain 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} from the frozen encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} . Since ℰ \mathcal{E} compresses at fixed factors, we reduce the video first. paragraphs.en: Residual encoding. The residual encoder ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} has the same architecture as ℰ \mathcal{E} , but takes the full-resolution video, so it needs an additional compression step to match the target resolution. In the pretrained encoder, four downsampling stages are followed by middle blocks that refine the feature at the final resolution through residual and attention layers, and then by a head that projects it to the latent. We add one downsample block between the middle blocks and the head. The block reuses the design of the pretrained downsample blocks, which pass the feature through two residual blocks before a strided convolution over space and a strided causal convolution over time. We attach a non-parametric shortcut to this block, following the residual autoencoding of DC-AE ( Chen et al., 2025a ) . Since the block compresses time as well as space, the shortcut moves both axes into the channel axis, then averages channel groups to match the channel number of the block output. Its result is added to the block output, which leaves the block to learn the residual.
paragraphs.zh: 残差编码。 残差编码器 ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} 与 ℰ \mathcal{E} 采用相同的架构，但需要处理全分辨率视频，因此必须增加一个压缩步骤以匹配目标分辨率。 在预训练编码器中，四个下采样阶段之后是中间模块，这些模块通过残差层和注意力层在最终分辨率上优化特征，随后是一个将其投影到潜在空间的头部模块。 我们在中间模块与头部模块之间添加一个下采样模块。 该模块复用了预训练下采样模块的设计：特征先经过两个残差模块，然后进行空间上的步长卷积和时间上的因果步长卷积。 我们遵循 DC-AE（Chen et al., 2025a）的残差自编码方法，为该模块添加一个非参数化捷径连接。 由于该模块同时压缩时间和空间，捷径连接将两个轴都转移到通道轴上，然后对通道组进行平均，以匹配模块输出的通道数量。 其结果会与模块输出相加，从而让该模块学习残差部分。

sents.zh: 残差编码。

sents.en: The residual encoder ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} has the same architecture as ℰ \mathcal{E} , but takes the full-resolution video, so it needs an additional compression step to match the target resolution.
sents.zh: 残差编码器 ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} 与 ℰ \mathcal{E} 采用相同的架构，但需要处理全分辨率视频，因此必须增加一个压缩步骤以匹配目标分辨率。

sents.en: In the pretrained encoder, four downsampling stages are followed by middle blocks that refine the feature at the final resolution through residual and attention layers, and then by a head that projects it to the latent.
sents.zh: 在预训练编码器中，四个下采样阶段之后是中间模块，这些模块通过残差层和注意力层在最终分辨率上优化特征，随后是一个将其投影到潜在空间的头部模块。

sents.en: We add one downsample block between the middle blocks and the head.
sents.zh: 我们在中间模块与头部模块之间添加一个下采样模块。

sents.en: The block reuses the design of the pretrained downsample blocks, which pass the feature through two residual blocks before a strided convolution over space and a strided causal convolution over time.
sents.zh: 该模块复用了预训练下采样模块的设计：特征先经过两个残差模块，然后进行空间上的步长卷积和时间上的因果步长卷积。

sents.en: We attach a non-parametric shortcut to this block, following the residual autoencoding of DC-AE ( Chen et al., 2025a ) .
sents.zh: 我们遵循 DC-AE（Chen et al., 2025a）的残差自编码方法，为该模块添加一个非参数化捷径连接。

sents.en: Since the block compresses time as well as space, the shortcut moves both axes into the channel axis, then averages channel groups to match the channel number of the block output.
sents.zh: 由于该模块同时压缩时间和空间，捷径连接将两个轴都转移到通道轴上，然后对通道组进行平均，以匹配模块输出的通道数量。

sents.en: Its result is added to the block output, which leaves the block to learn the residual.
sents.zh: 其结果会与模块输出相加，从而让该模块学习残差部分。

paragraphs.en: Decoding. The decoder 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} extends the input convolution of 𝒟 \mathcal{D} from C C to C + C ′ C{+}C^{\prime} channels for the concatenated latent, and adds one upsample block symmetric to the downsample block of ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} . The weights for the residual channels are zero-initialized, so training starts at the pretrained reconstruction quality. The non-parametric shortcut of this block runs in the opposite direction, duplicating channels and then applying a channel-to-space-and-time operation. In the image-to-video setting, the first frame is available at inference as well as during training, and we pass it to 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} to restore detail the compressed latent cannot carry on its own. We encode the first frame with ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} and inject its intermediate features into 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} through gated cross-attention ( Tian et al., 2025 ) . We take the feature before each downsampling stage of the encoder and attend to it at the matching stage of 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} . A learned gate on each block controls how much of the first frame reaches 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} .
paragraphs.zh: 解码。 解码器 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} 将 𝒟 \mathcal{D} 的输入卷积从 C C 通道扩展到 C + C ′ C{+}C^{\prime} 通道以处理拼接后的潜在表示，并添加一个与 ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} 的下采样块对称的上采样块。 残差通道的权重采用零初始化，因此训练从预训练的重建质量开始。 该块的非参数化捷径以相反方向运行，先复制通道，然后执行通道到空间和时间维度的操作。 在图像到视频的设置中，推理阶段和训练阶段都可以使用第一帧，我们会将其传入 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}}，以恢复压缩后的潜在表示自身无法携带的细节。 我们用 ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} 对第一帧进行编码，并通过门控交叉注意力（Tian et al., 2025）将其中间特征注入到 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} 中。 我们提取编码器每个下采样阶段之前的特征，并在 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} 的对应阶段对其进行注意力处理。 每个块上的一个可学习门控机制控制第一帧有多少信息能够传递到 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}}。

paragraphs.en: Single-latent baseline. The baseline replaces the base and residual pair with a single encoder, so there is no frozen ℰ \mathcal{E} and no reduction of the input. The compression block keeps the same design and placement, and both the non-parametric shortcut and the first-frame cross-attention are unchanged.

paragraphs.en: We train the autoencoder in two phases. In the first phase, we update ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} and 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} at 256 × 256 × 81 256{\times}256{\times}81 , along with W in res W^{\text{res}}_{\text{in}} and the per-layer projections P l P_{l} . All other parameters of 𝐯 θ \mathbf{v}_{\theta} and 𝐯 θ , + \mathbf{v}_{\theta,+} remain frozen. In the second phase, we raise the resolution to 512 × 512 × 81 512{\times}512{\times}81 and train 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} alone, following the decoupled high-resolution adaptation of DC-AE ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , which freezes ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} as well so that the latent space stays fixed while the decoder adapts. ℰ \mathcal{E} stays frozen in both phases. We train a separate autoencoder for each task, with ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} supervised by the pretrained DiT of that task, and report reconstruction with the image-to-video autoencoder.

paragraphs.en: Training setup. We train on Panda-70M ( Chen et al., 2024 ) with AdamW, using the hyperparameters in Tab. A.1 . The clip length stays at 81 81 frames, since reconstruction degrades quickly on shorter clips under high temporal compression. The modules we add on the DiT side, W in res W^{\text{res}}_{\text{in}} and P l P_{l} , are trained with a separate learning rate.

paragraphs.en: Timestep conditioning. The base and the residual latents are denoised at different noise levels, so the DiT receives two timesteps. paragraphs.en: This section details how the pretrained DiT is adapted to each compared autoencoder in Tab. 1 . Our own autoencoder is adapted as described in Section 4.3 , which extends the pretrained input and output projections and denoises the base ahead of the residual. Both steps build on the base latent from the frozen Wan2.1 encoder, which is unavailable to the compared autoencoders, as their latent spaces are entirely different from the one the DiT was trained on. For each of them, we therefore adapt Wan2.1-I2V-14B with the released implementation of DC-Gen ( He et al., 2026 ) , a recent method that adapts a pretrained DiT to a new latent space in three stages: first the patch embedding, then the input and output layers, and finally the whole transformer with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) . Each autoencoder keeps the patch size of 1 used in its original generation model. This adaptation uses the same total budget of 38.5 H200 GPU days as our full pipeline, and all other settings are shared.
paragraphs.zh: 本节详细说明了如何将预训练的 DiT 适配到表 1 中每个被比较的自编码器。 我们自己的自编码器按照第 4.3 节的描述进行适配，该部分扩展了预训练的输入和输出投影，并在残差处理前对基础模型进行去噪。 这两个步骤都基于冻结的 Wan2.1 编码器提供的基潜在空间，而这一空间在比较的自编码器中并不可用，因为它们的潜在空间与 DiT 训练时使用的空间完全不同。 因此，对于每个自编码器，我们都使用 DC-Gen（He et al., 2026）的已发布实现来适配 Wan2.1-I2V-14B。这是一种近期方法，通过三个阶段将预训练的 DiT 适配到新的潜在空间：首先是块嵌入，然后是输入和输出层，最后是结合 LoRA（Hu et al., 2021）对整个变换器进行适配。 每个自编码器都保留了其原始生成模型中使用的 1 的块大小。 这种适配使用了与我们完整流程相同的总计算预算，即 38.5 H200 GPU 天，并且所有其他设置也保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Generation comparison. Every model adapted from Wan2.1, including ours, the single-latent baseline, and the latents in Tab. 1 , is sampled with a guidance scale of 5.0 and a flow shift of 3.0 on the full prompt and conditioning image set of VBench-I2V ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . The other generators in Tab. 2 are run from their released checkpoints, the 13B development release of LTX-Video 0.9.7, the high-compression Video DC-AE release of Open-Sora 2.0, and the released DC-Gen model ( He et al., 2026 ) . We run LTX-Video as a single 50-step pass at the target resolution, without its multiscale pipeline and spatial upscaler, so that every model denoises the same number of steps at the same resolution. For text-to-video, each model is run with the prompt pipeline recommended by its authors: Wan2.1-14B, GRACE, and DC-Gen each use GPT-enhanced prompts from the VBench release, LTX-Video uses its built-in prompt enhancer, and Open-Sora 2.0 follows its default text-to-image-to-video path without prompt refinement. For image-to-video, VBench-I2V provides only short prompts. We expand them once with GPT-4o ( OpenAI et al., 2024 ) and use the same expanded set for Wan2.1-14B, GRACE, and Open-Sora 2.0, which do not release prompts for this setting. DC-Gen uses the extended prompts released with it, and LTX-Video uses its built-in prompt enhancer. Every model takes 50 sampling steps, but the number of forward passes through the DiT differs. LTX-Video combines classifier-free guidance with spatio-temporal guidance, and Open-Sora 2.0 guides on text and image separately, so both evaluate the DiT three times per step rather than twice. Latency covers the conditioning encode, the denoising loop, and the decode of the output video, measured on a single NVIDIA A100 SXM4-80GB in PyTorch with bfloat16 and no inference-time compilation. It excludes model loading, text encoding, and writing the decoded frames to an MP4 file, none of which depend on the latent resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 生成结果对比。 所有基于 Wan2.1 改进的模型（包括我们的模型、单潜在基线模型以及表 1 中的潜在模型）均在 VBench-I2V 的完整提示词和条件图像集上，以引导尺度 5.0 和流偏移量 3.0 进行采样（Huang et al., 2023；Huang et al., 2024）。 表 2 中的其他生成器均使用其已发布的检查点运行：LTX-Video 0.9.7 的 13B 开发版、Open-Sora 2.0 的高压缩 Video DC-AE 版本，以及已发布的 DC-Gen 模型（He et al., 2026）。 我们将 LTX-Video 以单次 50 步处理在目标分辨率下运行，不使用其多尺度管道和空间上采样器，以确保所有模型在相同分辨率下执行相同数量的去噪步骤。 对于文本到视频生成，每个模型均按照其作者推荐的提示词流程运行：Wan2.1-14B、GRACE 和 DC-Gen 均使用 VBench 版本中经 GPT 增强的提示词；LTX-Video 使用其内置的提示词增强器；Open-Sora 2.0 则遵循默认的文本到图像再到视频的流程，不进行提示词优化。 对于图像到视频生成，VBench-I2V 仅提供简短的提示词。 我们首先使用 GPT-4o（OpenAI et al., 2024）对这些提示词进行一次扩展，并将相同的扩展提示词集用于 Wan2.1-14B、GRACE 和 Open-Sora 2.0，因为这些模型未发布该设置下的提示词。 DC-Gen 使用随其一同发布的扩展提示词，而 LTX-Video 则使用其内置的提示词增强器。 所有模型均执行 50 次采样步骤，但通过 DiT 的前向传播次数有所不同。 LTX-Video 将无分类器引导与时空引导相结合，而 Open-Sora 2.0 则对文本和图像分别进行引导，因此两者在每一步中都会对 DiT 执行三次评估，而非两次。 延迟时间包括条件编码、去噪循环以及输出视频的解码过程，测量环境为单台 NVIDIA A100 SXM4-80GB 显卡，使用 PyTorch、bfloat16 格式且无推理时编译优化。 该延迟时间不包括模型加载、文本编码以及将解码后的帧写入 MP4 文件的过程，因为这些步骤均不依赖于潜在分辨率。

paragraphs.en: Latent uniformity. Following VA-VAE ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , we measure how evenly the latent tokens are distributed. We encode 10,000 10{,}000 clips at 256 × 256 × 81 256{\times}256{\times}81 , each from a distinct source video in the Panda-70M ( Chen et al., 2024 ) training split, and keep one token per clip, sampled at a random spatio-temporal position. Every autoencoder is probed at the same clips and positions. The tokens are standardized per channel and embedded with t-SNE ( van der Maaten and Hinton, 2008 ) at a perplexity of 30 30 , and we report the coefficient of variation, Gini coefficient, and normalized entropy of a Gaussian kernel density estimate on the embedding, averaged over two t-SNE seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在均匀性。 遵循 VA-VAE（Yao 等人，2025），我们衡量潜在标记的分布均匀程度。 我们对 10,000 个 256 × 256 × 81 的视频片段进行编码，每个片段均来自 Panda-70M（Chen 等人，2024）训练集中不同的源视频，并保留每个片段中一个在随机时空位置采样的标记。 每个自编码器都在相同的片段和位置上被探测。 这些标记按通道进行标准化，并使用 t-SNE（van der Maaten 和 Hinton，2008）以 30 的困惑度进行嵌入；我们报告了嵌入结果中高斯核密度估计的变异系数、吉尼系数和归一化熵，并对两个 t-SNE 种子进行了平均。

paragraphs.en: For Tab. 5 , we use the frozen V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) ViT-L encoder at 256 × 256 256{\times}256 , whose 16 × 16 16{\times}16 patch grid already matches the spatial grid of our f16 latent, so no spatial interpolation is needed. Since V-JEPA 2.1 is trained on clips of up to 64 frames, we apply the alignment to the first 65 frames of each 81-frame training clip. Our causal latent encodes the first frame on its own, so we encode it with V-JEPA 2.1 separately and align it with the first latent frame. Each remaining latent frame covers 8 frames and corresponds to four V-JEPA 2.1 tokens of 2 frames each, so a learnable transposed 3D convolution upsamples these latent frames 4 × 4\times in time to match. We align to the features of block 23, the final block of the encoder, whose output V-JEPA 2.1 uses directly for dense downstream tasks ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) . The alignment uses the same per-token cosine loss and adaptive weighting as ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} .
paragraphs.zh: 对于表 5，我们使用冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1（Mur-Labadia 等人，2026）ViT-L 编码器，分辨率为 256×256 256{\times}256，其 16×16 16{\times}16 的块网格已经与我们的 f16 潜在表示的空间网格匹配，因此无需进行空间插值。 由于 V-JEPA 2.1 是在最多包含 64 帧的视频片段上训练的，我们将对齐操作应用于每个 81 帧训练片段的前 65 帧。 我们的因果潜在表示单独编码第一帧，因此我们使用 V-JEPA 2.1 对其进行单独编码，并将其与第一个潜在帧进行对齐。 每个剩余的潜在帧覆盖 8 帧，并对应于四个 V-JEPA 2.1 的令牌（每个令牌包含 2 帧），因此一个可学习的转置三维卷积在时间维度上将这些潜在帧上采样 4×4\times，以实现匹配。 我们对齐到第 23 个块的特征，即编码器的最后一个块，其输出被 V-JEPA 2.1 直接用于密集的下游任务（Mur-Labadia 等人，2026）。 该对齐过程使用与 ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} 相同的每个令牌的余弦损失和自适应加权方法。

paragraphs.en: Aesthetic quality. DC-Gen scores above GRACE on this dimension in T2V settings, while scoring below on every total. We observe that its samples are consistently more saturated than those of the pretrained pipeline (Figs. I.1 – I.4 ), and the LAION aesthetic predictor behind this dimension has been shown to track photographic taste rather than fidelity to the prompt or to the conditioning image ( Taylor et al., 2026 ) . The dimension therefore rewards a shift in appearance that the other dimensions penalize.
paragraphs.zh: 美学质量。在 T2V 设置中，DC-Gen 在此维度上的得分高于 GRACE，但在所有其他总分上均低于后者。我们观察到，其生成的样本始终比预训练流程的样本饱和度更高（图 I.1 – I.4），并且驱动该维度的 LAION 美学预测模型已被证明更倾向于反映摄影审美偏好，而非对提示或条件图像的忠实度（Taylor 等，2026）。因此，这一维度奖励了外观上的变化，而这种变化在其他维度上则会受到惩罚。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a blind user study comparing our method with Wan2.1-14B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and the adaptation-based DC-Gen ( He et al., 2026 ) in both the T2V and I2V settings, using 40 prompts randomly selected per setting from VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) (with their conditioning images for I2V). Each model uses its own prompt extension; participants see the original VBench prompt. Participants view two videos generated from the same prompt, ours and one baseline, in randomized A/B order, and judge which is better in visual quality (fewer unnatural colors or shapes and a better overall appearance), temporal consistency (no flicker, stutter, or objects changing over time), and text alignment (the subjects, actions, details, and style described in the prompt), with an “about equal” option for each. 39 human raters each rated 16 pairs, eight per setting, so each of the 160 comparison pairs is rated by at least 3 different participants, giving 156 votes per setting, baseline, and criterion. Tab. D.3 reports the win, tie, and loss rates of our method.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 T2V 和 I2V 两种设置中，对我们的方法与 Wan2.1-14B（Wan 等人，2025）以及基于适配的 DC-Gen（He 等人，2026）进行了盲测用户研究。研究中，我们从 VBench（Huang 等人，2023；Huang 等人，2024）中为每种设置随机选择了 40 条提示（I2V 设置还使用了相应的条件图像）。每个模型都使用其自身的提示扩展；参与者看到的是原始的 VBench 提示。参与者会观看由同一提示生成的两个视频：我们的模型生成的视频和一个基线模型生成的视频，两者以随机打乱的 A/B 顺序呈现。他们需要判断哪个视频在视觉质量（更少不自然的颜色或形状，以及更佳的总体外观）、时间一致性（无闪烁、卡顿或物体随时间变化）和文本对齐（与提示中描述的主体、动作、细节和风格相符）方面表现更好，每个标准都提供“大致相当”的选项。共有 39 名人类评分员参与，每人评估了 16 对视频，每种设置各 8 对。因此，160 个比较对中每一对至少由 3 名不同参与者进行了评估，使得每种设置、每个基线模型和每个标准都获得了 156 票。表 D.3 报告了我们方法的获胜、打平和失败率。

paragraphs.en: Against DC-Gen, which also operates in a compressed latent space, participants prefer our model by a wide margin in both settings, choosing it in 60.3–71.2% of the votes on visual quality and temporal consistency against 14.1–24.4% for DC-Gen. Against Wan2.1-14B before compression, our model is preferred in T2V on all three criteria, with 46.8–52.6% of the votes against 25.6–35.3%, whereas Wan2.1-14B is preferred in I2V with 34.6–44.9% against 22.4–29.5%. In I2V, many votes also rate the two as about equal, up to 42.9% for text alignment. Figs. D.1 and D.2 show the interface used in the study.
paragraphs.zh: 在与同样在压缩潜在空间中运行的 DC-Gen 的对比中，参与者在两种设置下都以较大优势偏好我们的模型：在视觉质量和时间一致性方面的投票中，选择我们模型的占比为 60.3–71.2%，而选择 DC-Gen 的占比仅为 14.1–24.4%。在与压缩前的 Wan2.1-14B 的对比中，我们的模型在 T2V 任务上依据所有三项标准均更受青睐，投票占比为 46.8–52.6%，而 Wan2.1-14B 的占比为 25.6–35.3%；但在 I2V 任务中，Wan2.1-14B 更受偏好，其投票占比为 34.6–44.9%，而我们的模型仅为 22.4–29.5%。在 I2V 任务中，许多投票也认为两者表现大致相当，其中文本对齐方面的比例最高，达到 42.9%。图 D.1 和图 D.2 展示了研究中使用的界面。

paragraphs.en: We examine the design choices behind the autoencoder that are not covered in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: First-frame conditioning. For image-to-video, 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} receives the first frame through gated cross-attention. We drop it with probability 0.5 0.5 during training, so that the decoder learns to reconstruct without it and relies on the compressed latent rather than copying from the first frame. Even without the first frame at inference, reconstruction stays close to that with it (Tab. E.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 首帧条件约束。 对于图像到视频的任务，𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} 通过门控交叉注意力接收第一帧。 在训练期间，我们以 0.5 的概率丢弃该帧，这样解码器就能学会在没有它的情况下进行重建，并依赖压缩后的潜在表示，而不是直接复制第一帧的内容。 即使在推理时没有第一帧，重建结果仍然与包含第一帧时的结果非常接近（表 E.1）。

paragraphs.en: Alignment depth. We compare supervising the first 10 blocks of the DiT with supervising all 40. As Tab. E.2 shows, the two settings generate at the same level, within 0.04 on the I2V total, but supervising all 40 loses 0.42 dB in PSNR, raises LPIPS from 0.032 to 0.038, and converges more slowly. The later blocks likely conflict with ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}} more strongly, so the encoder spends its capacity on matching them rather than on reconstruction. We therefore supervise the first 10.
paragraphs.zh: 对齐深度。我们将监督 DiT 的前 10 个块与监督全部 40 个块进行了比较。如表 E.2 所示，两种设置生成的结果处于同一水平，I2V 总得分差异在 0.04 以内；但监督全部 40 个块会导致 PSNR 下降 0.42 dB，LPIPS 从 0.032 上升至 0.038，且收敛速度更慢。后几个块可能与重建损失 ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}} 产生更强的冲突，因此编码器会将资源用于匹配这些块，而非进行重建。因此，我们选择监督前 10 个块。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we look into what the base and the residual latent each contain, first by perturbing one part while the other stays clean and then through their principal components.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将探究基础潜在变量和残差潜在变量各自包含的内容：首先通过扰动其中一个部分而保持另一个部分纯净，然后分析它们的主成分。

paragraphs.en: Per-latent analysis on reconstruction. We analyze how 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} and 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} each affect the reconstruction performance by injecting a controlled amount of noise into one of them while keeping the other clean. Fig. F.1 sweeps τ \tau from 0 0 to 1 1 in the flow matching interpolation of Eq. 2 , so that τ = 0 \tau=0 leaves the latent unchanged and τ = 1 \tau=1 replaces it with pure noise. The noise is scaled by the per-channel variance of the latent it is added to. We report PSNR and LPIPS on Panda-70M ( Chen et al., 2024 ) at 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 for each level.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在变量重建的逐潜在变量分析。我们通过向 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 和 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} 之一注入受控量的噪声，同时保持另一个干净，来分析它们各自如何影响重建性能。图 F.1 在公式 2 的流匹配插值中，将 τ \tau 从 0 0 到 1 1 进行扫描，因此当 τ = 0 \tau=0 时，潜在变量保持不变；而当 τ = 1 \tau=1 时，则将其替换为纯噪声。噪声的幅度由所添加潜在变量的逐通道方差进行缩放。我们对每个级别在 Panda-70M（Chen et al., 2024）上以 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 的分辨率报告了 PSNR 和 LPIPS 指标。

paragraphs.en: As plotted in Fig. F.1 (a), both PSNR and LPIPS degrade steadily for either latent under noise, and faster for 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} across the whole range. Fig. F.1 (b) also shows that both 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} and 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} fail in different ways, with 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} breaking the spatial layout of the scene while 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} keeps the layout and instead blurs each frame and makes the motion appear at a lower frame rate. This is expected from the design, since the reduction in space and time leaves the overall scene in 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} while 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} carries what the reduction removes and the motion between the sampled frames. The larger drop for 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} follows as well, and it is what we intend: 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} stays in the space the DiT was pretrained on, so the latent that carries more of the reconstruction is also the one that needs the least adaptation. The burden of Stage 2 therefore falls on 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} , which lies outside the space the pretrained DiT was trained on. A video built from 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} alone would show blurred frames and motion that steps between the sampled frames rather than flowing through them, precisely what 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} was trained to restore.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 F.1 (a) 所示，无论潜在表示是否包含噪声，PSNR 和 LPIPS 都会持续下降，并且在整个范围内，𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 的下降速度更快。图 F.1 (b) 也显示，𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 和 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} 都以不同方式失效：𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 破坏了场景的空间布局，而 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} 虽然保留了空间布局，却使每一帧都变得模糊，并让运动看起来像是以较低的帧率呈现。这种结果符合其设计预期，因为空间和时间信息的减少使得 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 保留了整体场景，而 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} 则承载了被削减掉的信息以及采样帧之间的运动。因此，𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 的下降幅度更大，这也是我们所期望的结果：𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 仍处于 DiT 预训练所处的空间范围内，因此承载更多重建信息的潜在表示也最需要最少的调整。所以，阶段 2 的任务负担就落在了 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} 上，因为它位于预训练 DiT 所训练的空间范围之外。仅由 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 构建的视频会显示模糊的帧和仅在采样帧之间跳跃而非流畅过渡的运动，而这正是 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} 被训练用来恢复的效果。

paragraphs.en: PCA visualization. Fig. F.2 visualizes the Principal Component Analysis (PCA) of 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} and 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} across video frames, encoded from a 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 video. The three leading components are computed per clip and mapped to RGB, so colors are not comparable across panels. The components of 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} are semantically organized, following the objects in the frame. Without ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} , noise dominates the components of 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} , which show little of the scene. ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} suppresses much of that noise and brings out the objects, and 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} occasionally resolves them at an even coarser scale than 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} . Note that 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} is identical in both settings, since ℰ \mathcal{E} is frozen.
paragraphs.zh: PCA 可视化。图 F.2 展示了从一段 480 × 832 × 81 的视频中编码得到的 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 和 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} 在各视频帧上的主成分分析（PCA）结果。每个片段都会计算前三个主成分并将其映射到 RGB 空间，因此不同子图中的颜色不具备可比性。𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 的主成分在语义上是组织有序的，能够跟随画面中的物体分布。在没有 ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} 的情况下，噪声主导了 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} 的主成分，导致其几乎无法反映场景内容。ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} 抑制了大部分噪声并凸显了物体，而 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} 偶尔甚至能以比 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 更粗略的尺度分辨出这些物体。需要注意的是，由于 ℰ \mathcal{E} 是固定的，因此在两种设置中 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} 都是相同的。

The base channels behave almost identically with and without alignment, since the DiT already models that space and has little to adapt. The two runs separate only on the residual, which converges faster and reaches a lower loss with alignment, so the gain in Fig. 7 does not come at the cost of the base.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 追踪了 DiT 适应过程中残差通道上的流匹配损失。图 F.3 补充了相同运行下的基础通道，这些通道在除 ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} 外的所有设置下均保持一致训练，且每个部分都通过其自身的统计量进行了标准化。 无论是否进行对齐，基础通道的表现几乎完全相同，因为 DiT 已经对该空间进行了建模，因此几乎没有需要适应的部分。 两次运行仅在残差部分出现差异，而该部分在对齐的情况下收敛更快且损失更低，因此图 7 中的增益并非以牺牲基础通道为代价获得的。

paragraphs.en: Improving the latent space for generation. Beyond compression, several works improve the latent space itself so that the diffusion model learns it more easily ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025c ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . These works mostly train the generation model from scratch on the resulting latent, whereas we shape the latent so that an already trained model can be reused.
paragraphs.zh: 改进生成所用的潜在空间。 除了压缩之外，一些研究还改进了潜在空间本身，使扩散模型能更轻松地学习它（Zheng et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025c；Wu et al., 2024）。 这些研究大多从头开始在生成的潜在空间上训练生成模型，而我们的方法则是塑造潜在空间，以便能够复用已经训练好的模型。

paragraphs.en: Efficient video autoencoder architectures. Compared to images, video carries an additional temporal dimension, which makes the autoencoder both harder to design and more expensive to run. Wavelet-based designs reduce this cost by replacing part of the convolutional stack with a fixed multi-resolution transform ( Li et al., 2025 ; Cheng and Yuan, 2025 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) . These reduce the cost of the autoencoder itself rather than the token count the diffusion model processes.
paragraphs.zh: 高效的视频自动编码器架构。 与图像相比，视频多了一个时间维度，这使得自动编码器的设计更加困难，运行成本也更高。 基于小波的设计通过用固定的多分辨率变换替换部分卷积堆栈来降低这一成本（Li 等人，2025；Cheng 和 Yuan，2025；NVIDIA 等，2025）。 这些设计降低了自动编码器本身的成本，而不是扩散模型处理的令牌数量。

paragraphs.en: This section collects the qualitative samples referenced throughout the paper: image-to-video and text-to-video generation at 480 × 832 480{\times}832 (Figs. I.1 – I.4 ), text-to-video generation at 736 × 1280 736{\times}1280 (Figs. I.5 and I.6 ), image-to-video generation at 736 × 1280 736{\times}1280 against LTX-Video ( HaCohen et al., 2024 ) (Figs. I.7 – I.9 ), generation in various styles (Fig. I.10 ), and further latent visualizations (Figs. I.11 and I.12 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本节汇集了论文中引用的定性样本：分辨率为 480 × 832 480{\times}832 的图像到视频和文本到视频生成（图 I.1 – I.4），分辨率为 736 × 1280 736{\times}1280 的文本到视频生成（图 I.5 和 I.6），与 LTX-Video（HaCohen 等人，2024）对比的分辨率为 736 × 1280 736{\times}1280 的图像到视频生成（图 I.7 – I.9），不同风格的生成结果（图 I.10），以及进一步的潜在空间可视化（图 I.11 和 I.12）。

paragraphs.en: Compressing the latent leaves fewer tokens for each frame, and small objects suffer the most. Distant faces, text on signs, and thin structures are often lost or broken, while the overall scene and its motion stay intact. The effect shows in Figs. I.3 and I.4 , and it is weaker at 736 × 1280 736{\times}1280 , where the same compression ratio leaves more tokens per frame. GRACE-VAE is also optimized for the DiT rather than for reconstruction alone, and trades some reconstruction fidelity for generation quality. At the same token count, its PSNR is 1.13 dB below our single-latent baseline (Tab. 1 ). Adding more residual channels could recover more of this detail, but adapting a pretrained DiT to a higher-dimensional latent is itself difficult ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , and we leave this to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 对潜在表示进行压缩会减少每帧的令牌数量，而小物体受到的影响最大。远处的面孔、标志上的文字以及纤细的结构常常会被丢失或破坏，但整体场景及其运动仍然保持完整。这一效果可见于图 I.3 和 I.4，在 736 × 1280 736{\times}1280 分辨率下，这种影响较弱，因为相同的压缩比率此时每帧保留的令牌更多。GRACE-VAE 也是针对 DiT 进行优化的，而不仅仅是为了重建，因此它在一定程度上牺牲了重建保真度以换取生成质量。在相同的令牌数量下，其 PSNR 比我们的单潜在基线模型低 1.13 dB（表 1）。增加更多残差通道或许能够恢复更多的细节，但将预训练的 DiT 适配到更高维度的潜在表示本身就是一个难题（Zheng et al., 2026），因此我们将此问题留待未来研究。

paragraphs.en: Applying GRACE to a new pretrained pipeline also requires training a new autoencoder, since the base latent comes from that pipeline’s frozen encoder and ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} is supervised by its DiT. Each new pipeline therefore costs one more Stage 1 run, 8.5 H200 GPU days in our setting.
paragraphs.zh: 将 GRACE 应用于新的预训练管道还需要训练一个新的自编码器，因为基础潜在变量来自该管道的冻结编码器，而 ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} 则由其 DiT 进行监督。 因此，每个新管道都需要额外进行一次阶段 1 的运行，在我们设定的环境中需要消耗 8.5 个 H200 GPU 日。
